329:t_1:4.en:
$$レモン$$
「...That's amazing, $$ナミ$$! To think you moved up to Class A while I was away!」

329:t_1:5.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's thanks to $$宗介$$. It was one thrilling match after another.」

329:t_1:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「I told you when we first met. That I'm a professional.」

329:t_1:9.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It'll be three weeks since that day soon, but... I realized I don't know much about you, $$宗介$$...」

329:t_1:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I'm not good at talking about myself.」

329:t_1:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not that it makes up for it, but tell me about yourself.」

329:t_1:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's see... Why you own Team $$クロスボウ$$, how you got your Rk-91, things like that...」

329:t_1:14.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I found it. About a year and a half ago, on the edge of my home village.」

329:t_1:16.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Back then my village was caught up in the $$クメン$$ civil war. The AS was left behind by the people who burned half of the village down.」

329:t_1:17.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Though it was practically scrap when I found it, so I repaired it myself.」

329:t_1:19.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I want to rebuild that village. But that takes a lot of money...」

329:t_1:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「So that's why you enter the arena.」

329:t_1:21.en:
$$ナミ$$
「If I use the money I earn to restore the ruined fields and roads, people are sure to come back.」

329:t_1:22.en:
$$ナミ$$
「And my goal right now is to rebuild the only school in the village, the one I went to.」

329:t_1:24.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Did you go to school in Japan too, $$宗介$$?」

329:t_1:26.en:
$$宗介$$
(...What am I doing here now?)

329:t_1:27.en:
$$宗介$$
(Through $$ミスリル$$'s investigation, I had learned that an organization that seems to be $$アマルガム$$ is behind this $$ナムサク$$ arena, but...)

329:t_1:28.en:
$$宗介$$
(With everyone from $c gone, can I really find $$千鳥$$ by going on like this...?)

329:t_1:29.en:
$$宗介$$
(But to get a lead on the enemy, there is no choice but to gather information steadily.)

329:t_1:30.en:
$$宗介$$
(...Is that really the only reason I'm here...?)

329:t_1:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「Nothing... I was thinking about tomorrow's opponent.」

329:t_1:33.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I see... Then I'll go update the control software for the fire control system.」

329:t_1:34.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's homemade, so it can't do much, but it'll make $$クロスボウ$$ even stronger.」

329:t_1:38.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You looked cool in today's match, $$宗介$$.」

329:t_1:40.en:
$$宗介$$
(If I stay here, there are none of the harsh missions I had at $c...)

329:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
(None of the hardships of playing a high school student in Tokyo, either...)

329:t_1:42.en:
$$宗介$$
(Dealing with $$アマルガム$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$ can be left to someone other than me. It is not my duty.)

329:t_1:43.en:
$$宗介$$
(It has not even been a month since then, and honestly, I'm starting to think this life isn't so bad...)

329:t_1:45.en:
$$宗介$$
(...I can't remember the color of the shoes $$千鳥$$ often wore... or which wrist she wore her watch on...)

329:t_1:46.en:
$$宗介$$
(I even forgot the color of the ribbon that tied up that long hair I must have always looked at...)

329:t_1:47.en:
$$宗介$$
(Worse than that... I'm even losing the ability to remember her smile...)

329:t_1:50.en:
$$レモン$$
「'Were you here?' That's not the point. I called out to you several times and you ignored me.」

329:t_1:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry... I was lost in thought.」

329:t_1:52.en:
$$レモン$$
「Want to step outside for a change of pace? There's something I'd like to talk about.」

329:t_1:58.en:
$$宗介$$
「...While we're at it, I'll look for the parts $$ナミ$$ wanted.」

329:t_1:59.en:
$$レモン$$
「I'm amazed. Arena or not, they sell AS parts in an ordinary market like this.」

329:t_1:60.en:
$$レモン$$
「All of this stuff is outdated, right? New AS models just keep getting developed, huh...」

329:t_1:61.en:
$$宗介$$
(...Major $$カリーニン$$ pointed it out too, but the speed of weapons evolution in the multiverse is abnormal.)

329:t_1:62.en:
$$宗介$$
(And it's not just AS. From what $$カミーユ$$ and the others say, mobile suits and other mobile weapons are the same.)

329:t_1:63.en:
$$宗介$$
(What they all have in common is that they're basically humanoid, but is that a coincidence...)

329:t_1:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not saying you can't take pictures. But isn't that a bit inconsiderate?」

329:t_1:66.en:
$$レモン$$
「Ah... that look stirred the artist in me, and I couldn't help...」

329:t_1:68.en:
$$レモン$$
「Truth is, I'm interested in your art too... your combat technique.」

329:t_1:69.en:
$$レモン$$
「Your magnificent way of fighting feels like it's already beyond mere skill. I sense art in it, as a photographer.」

329:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I've been told something similar before.」

329:t_1:71.en:
$$レモン$$
「You're different from the arena fighters. You're looking at some huge... far-off goal.」

329:t_1:72.en:
$$レモン$$
「Otherwise you couldn't have picked up that way of fighting. At least, that's what I felt.」

329:t_1:73.en:
$$宗介$$
(I thought he was just a carefree freelance reporter, but it seems that's not all he is...)

329:t_1:74.en:
$$レモン$$
「Well? Is my observation off the mark?」

329:t_1:75.en:
$$宗介$$
「You may be right. After all, the only means of expression I'm good at is this.」

329:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Did you drag me out here just to talk about that?」

329:t_1:78.en:
$$レモン$$
「I'll get straight to the point. ...Take $$ナミ$$ and leave the city.」

329:t_1:80.en:
$$レモン$$
「Soon, a big disturbance will break out in this city.」

329:t_1:81.en:
$$レモン$$
「According to my investigation, the people who ran the arena behind the scenes got too greedy, and apparently they're going to be purged by the higher-ups.」

329:t_1:83.en:
$$宗介$$
(Is $$アマルガム$$ going to burn this city...!?)

329:t_1:84.en:
$$レモン$$
「I don't want to see her caught up in that disturbance. ...Can I count on you, $$相良宗介$$... $$ウルズ$$ 7?」

329:t_1:85.en:
$$宗介$$
(This guy... why does he know my call sign...?)
